shifts.summary: The shift was overall Easy to Moderate, with 78–95 questions attempted well. Reasoning was mainly Moderate, GA varied between Easy and Moderate to Difficult, and Quant ranged from Easy to Advanced. English was Easy to Moderate. Time‑management and system issues affected performance.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Questions were lengthy, causing time pressure; many were statement‑wise and of moderate difficulty.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: Mostly factual; some candidates found it tough, especially if not well‑prepared.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Math ranged from easy to advanced; time‑management was a challenge.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Overall normal difficulty; some doubts but candidates performed well.

observations: System crash caused loss of about 10 minutes for many candidates.
Timer issues led to missed questions in math and reasoning sections.
Time‑management was highlighted as a challenge, especially in Quant.
Paper resembled previous year questions and cut‑off was expected to be high.
disagreements: GA difficulty split between Easy and Moderate to Difficult; Quant difficulty ranged from Easy to Advanced.
